backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, ExpenseEntry, PermissionRequest, Message, StudyMaterial, etc.) and integrating authorization and blob storage mixins for a family connection and educational support application.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting PWA implementation including manifest configuration, service worker offline support, iOS-specific meta tags, and app-like navigation patterns with associated test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including React components, pages, hooks, and configurations describing their functionality, data flow, and integration points.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with warm OKLCH color palette for light and dark modes, touch-optimized tap targets, safe area insets, and page transition animations.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with complete PWA meta tags including iOS-specific configurations, apple-touch-icon links, splash screen references, and manifest link.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata (name, description, display mode as standalone), theme colors, orientation, and icon set including maskable variants for adaptive icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache versioning, network-first strategy for API calls, cache-first for static assets, background sync support, and offline fallback responses.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application entry point that sets up TanStack Router with lazy-loaded pages (Dashboard, MediaGallery, Reminders, LocationSharing, Chat, EducationalHub, Settings, Onboarding). Handles authentication checks and redirects unauthenticated users to onboarding if they lack a user profile.
frontend/src/components/AIConflictAnalys: Component that analyzes family chat messages to detect conflicts (homework, screen time, curfew) and provides AI-generated remedies using formal parliamentary language. Includes pattern detection logic and displays conflict descriptions with suggested resolutions.
Displays study tips and performance insights fetched from backend queries. Shows AI-generated recommendations with analysis levels (basic/intermediate/advanced) and categorizes performance reviews with remedies.
frontend/src/components/ChatWidget.tsx: Draggable chat widget supporting group and private messaging with text, grocery lists, and social media links. Includes message type selection, recipient selection for private chats, and real-time message display with drag-to-reposition functionality.
frontend/src/components/DoubtClearingInt: Educational Q&A interface where users can submit questions and receive AI-generated answers. Maintains conversation history with timestamps and allows marking problems as resolved.
Analyzes weekly expenses across categories (fees, groceries, other) and generates personalized financial insights. Calculates spending percentages and provides tips, warnings, or success messages based on spending patterns.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseChart.tsx: Displays a horizontal bar chart showing weekly expenses by category (Fees, Groceries, Other) with totals, using data from useWeeklyExpenses hook.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseInput.tsx: Form component for parents to add expenses with category selection and amount input, using useAddExpense mutation.
frontend/src/components/FamilyMemberGrid: Displays a grid of family members (parents and children) with avatars and role badges, limited to 4 members.
frontend/src/components/FightsCreatedWid: Widget showing count of detected family conflicts with inline editing capability to manually adjust the counter.
frontend/src/components/FightsSolvedWidg: Widget displaying count of resolved family conflicts with inline editing capability to manually adjust the counter.
frontend/src/components/HappinessMeter.t: Displays family happiness score as a percentage with color-coded icon and progress bar based on score ranges.
frontend/src/components/InstallPromptBan: Fixed bottom banner prompting users to install the PWA to their home screen, with install and dismiss actions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component providing app structure with header, navigation bar, authentication controls, and swipe navigation support. Includes offline indicator, install prompt banner, chat widget, and handles Android back button events.
frontend/src/components/LoadingSpinner.t: Reusable loading spinner component with configurable sizes (sm/md/lg) using Lucide's Loader2 icon with animation.
frontend/src/components/OfflineIndicator: Displays a dismissible alert banner when the user goes offline, informing them that changes will sync when connection is restored.
frontend/src/components/PermissionApprov: Parent-facing interface to view and respond to permission requests from children, showing pending requests with activity type, reason, and approve/deny actions. Polls for new requests every 5 seconds.
frontend/src/components/PermissionReques: Child-facing form to request permission from parents for activities (go out, play games, watch YouTube), requiring activity type, reason, and parent selection.
frontend/src/components/ProblemsSolvedWi: Dashboard widget displaying the total count of family conflicts and educational problems successfully resolved, with trophy icon and badge.
frontend/src/components/ShareApp.tsx: Dialog component for sharing the app URL with family members, featuring copy-to-clipboard functionality and instructions for onboarding.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatWidget.ts: Custom hook managing chat widget state (open/closed) and position, persisting both values to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInstallPrompt.ts: React hook that manages PWA install prompt state, handling beforeinstallprompt events, tracking install/dismiss status with 7-day localStorage persistence, and providing methods to show or dismiss the install banner.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence via AuthClient, and providing login/logout functionality with configurable options for delegation and idle handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: React hook that monitors browser online/offline status using navigator.onLine and window events, returning current connectivity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Comprehensive React Query hooks for all backend canister interactions including user profiles, family management, expenses, messages, locations, permissions, educational data, and AI features with proper caching and invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSwipeNavigation.ts: React hook that implements touch swipe gesture detection for mobile navigation, triggering back navigation when user swipes right beyond a configurable threshold.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, family-friendly color palette for both light and dark modes using oklch color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Chat page component supporting group and private messaging with multiple message types (text, grocery lists, social media links), AI conflict analysis toggle, and real-time message display with family member selection.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that displays role-based content (parent or child views) with widgets for happiness tracking, problems/fights solved, permission management, AI conflict analysis, expense tracking, and family member grid.
frontend/src/pages/EducationalHub.tsx: Educational hub page with tabs for uploading question papers and answer scripts, viewing materials, AI analysis results, and a doubt-clearing interface with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/LocationSharing.tsx: Location sharing page that allows users to share their current GPS coordinates with family members and view family locations using the browser's geolocation API.
frontend/src/pages/MediaGallery.tsx: Media gallery page for uploading and displaying photos/videos with descriptions, showing upload progress, and displaying media shared by family members with timestamps.
frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.tsx: Onboarding page for new users to create their profile by selecting a role (parent or child), entering display name, and optionally processing family invitation tokens from URL parameters.
frontend/src/pages/Reminders.tsx: React page component for managing family reminders with create/list functionality, date-based status indicators (overdue/due soon/upcoming), and authentication-gated access requiring Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page component managing user profiles, family invitations, parent/child relationships, role changes, and AI remedy toggle with role-based access control (parent vs child permissions).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both standard query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (warm palette, semantic colors), spacing for safe areas, touch-friendly minimum sizes, and typography plugin integration.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking PWA conversion requirements including manifest enhancement, service worker implementation, iOS optimization, app-like navigation, install prompts, and mobile performance optimization features.
